title: Brazilian leftist President Lula wins reelection against conservative challenger Flavio Bolsonaro
summary: Leftist President Lula has defeated right-wing challenger Flavio Bolsonaro to win another term in office. DW has the latest.

image.caption: Lula has won in the second round of the election after losing to Bolsonaro in the first roundImage: Nelson Almeida/AFP

blocks.text: Brazil's Lula defeats conservative Flavio Bolsonaro in presidential election
Brazilian leftist President Lula has defeated right-wing challenger Flavio Bolsonaro for another term in office, the Brazilian electoral authorities said.
